authority_boundary: Architecture vocabulary only. This file creates no production-data, scientific, clinical, regulatory, conformance, institutional, release, or UNESCO authority.

temporal_semantics.rule: Missing or unknown temporal bounds remain explicit unknowns; retrieval time must not substitute for valid time or canonical acceptance time.

authority_rules: A source observation records source state and does not establish scientific truth.
A relationship or graph path does not establish assessment conformance, safety, efficacy, or regulatory authorization beyond the exact underlying decision.
Derived indicators are reproducible analytical outputs and cannot silently mutate canonical records.
Approximate entity matching cannot silently merge canonical identities.
Historical governing releases are immutable; corrections create successors.
Coverage claims are scoped to an identified source-universe version.
